title: digest_prompt
description: Digest projection of a prompt markdown file (prompts/prompt_NN_*.md). Captures structured facts extractable by Bash; prose nuance is handled inline by the Tier-2 reviewer against the raw file.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a prompt digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root (e.g. prompts/prompt_01_capabilities.md).

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

step_id.description: Pipeline step identifier derived from the filename (e.g. 01 from prompt_01_capabilities.md). Two digits optionally followed by a single letter.

schema_uri.description: The $schema URI declared inside the prompt (grep for '$schema' or 'vc:' URI pattern). Absent if not found. Tier-2 reviewers should treat missing field as equivalent to no schema URI declared.

shared_expectations_required.description: True if the prompt contains a REQUIRED directive to read shared_expectations.md before proceeding.

inputs.description: Upstream artifact file references explicitly mentioned as inputs (e.g. 00_charter.json). Derived from Extraction Intent section.

outputs.description: Reserved for future use; currently always empty. Tier-2 reviewers derive output artifacts from step_id + schema registry.

gates.description: Self-Audit Gate checklist items — lines beginning with a dash or checkbox inside the Self-Audit Gate section.

emergent_ambiguities_exit.description: True if the prompt contains an explicit declaration about emergent_ambiguities or coverage_gaps escape valve.

anchors.description: Named markdown anchors (<!-- anchor: name --> or heading IDs) found in the file. Useful for D6 cross-reference checks.

section_headers.description: All H2-level (##) section header texts in document order. Provides structural outline for drift detection.

negative_constraints_count.description: Count of lines in the Negative Constraints section (if present). Zero if section absent.

downstream_consumer_count.description: Number of downstream steps declared in the prompt header line (e.g. 'feeds 7 downstream steps' → 7). -1 if not declared.
